opportunities.title: Research Fund

amount.raw: up to £5000 of funding for 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) holding an independent research post; must not hold another active Research Fund grant. Undergraduate Student Members, Affiliates and Partner Scientists not eligible. Limited to one application per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Covers chemicals/equipment, consumables, specialist software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access. 2026 Round 2 opens 12 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over, a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account), or applying on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI. Project must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members, individuals and organisations to run chemistry-based engagement and outreach activities connecting communities with the chemical sciences. Open throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines; final deadline 2 October 2026.
